title: Image of a restricted linear series
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], let $X,C$ be schemes over $k$ [def-pc-scheme], and let $i:C\to X$ be a $k$-morphism. Let $L$ be a sheaf of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] and let $V\subseteq H^0(X,L)$ be a $k$-vector subspace, where $H^0$ is global module cohomology [def-sc-ringed-space-module-cohomology]. The restricted linear series image on $C$ is the $k$-vector subspace $\operatorname{im}(V\to H^0(C,i^*L))$, for the canonical section-pullback map $s\mapsto1\otimes s$ of the tensor pullback [def-pc-module-pullback]. Equivalently it is the $k$-span of these pullback values. No finite-dimensionality, invertibility, reducedness or closed-immersion hypothesis is required.
